newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Sept 23.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Sept. 23:

BRIDGETOWN, BARBADOS - The islands of the eastern Caribbean have become a key transit zone for cocaine and heroin headed to the United States, as well as for the banks that launder the illicit proceeds of the drug traffic.
WASHINGTON - Drug treatment programs in the Washington area are suffering under deep funding cuts.
WASHINGTON - Many rightwing Americans demonise the United Nations and see it as a central player in a global effort to strip away U.S. national rights and liberties.
WASHINGTON - Phone sex has gone global and countries like Guyana are raking in the profits.

CHARLOTTE, NORTH CAROLINA - In North Carolina, Senate Foreign Relations Committee Chairman Jesse Helms is campaigning for reelection, but his Democratic opponent Harvey Gantt starts out better known this time.
